memories.memory: I rent a small flat in the Docklands district of Northbridge and use a separate postal box for official correspondence because I move around frequently for work.
My current job is as a casework assistant at the Northbridge Civic Services Office, where my internal staff reference is PS-0005-2741.
I registered as Marco Rossi at a new GP practice in September 2024 after moving, and my patient file is linked to the fictional practice code NB-GP-1842.
My passport renewal appointment is booked for 18 October, and I keep the application papers in a locked drawer rather than carrying them to work.
I changed my mobile number after starting my public-sector job because my old number was still connected to several online accounts and former flatmates.
My younger sister is listed as my emergency contact at work, although she lives in another city and would need about three hours to reach me.
I once had to correct an employment record because the department had entered my surname as “Rossi-M” instead of “Rossi,” which delayed my first salary payment by nearly two weeks.
